interpretation: Five candidate responsibility hypotheses, not five proven independent causes. Diagnostic allocation is exclusive; physical clusters overlap families. May merge or split after localization.

families.name: Same-net drill intrusion into SMD lands
families.candidate_hypothesis: Same-net endpoint via placement does not preserve the stock no-via-in-pad condition.
families.confidence: LOW: geometry-informed candidate only; no internal-stage evidence

families.name: MCU pad escape clearance
families.candidate_hypothesis: Pad obstacle/rule treatment or subsequent escape geometry permits less than 0.20 mm clearance.
families.confidence: LOW: geometry-informed candidate only; no internal-stage evidence

families.name: Via annulus to unrelated-net routed copper
families.candidate_hypothesis: Via clearance budgeting, interaction with other routed copper, or later geometry changes permit less than 0.20 mm clearance.
families.confidence: LOW: geometry-informed candidate only; no internal-stage evidence

families.name: Inter-route clearance, including attached-pad diagnostics
families.candidate_hypothesis: Route-to-route spacing or later cleanup fails the 0.20 mm check. Some records share F2/F3 physical conflicts.
families.confidence: LOW: geometry-informed candidate only; no internal-stage evidence

families.name: Via annulus beside an NC MCU land
families.candidate_hypothesis: NC-pad obstacle clearance is insufficient; may share responsibility with F2/F3 rather than require a separate repair.
families.confidence: LOW: geometry-informed candidate only; no internal-stage evidence

recurring_signature.inference: Possible repeated clearance-budget signature. Numeric similarity alone does not prove the same fault or internal cause.

combined_mcu_pad_and_trace_symptoms.caution: 50.7% is a combined symptom population, not a demonstrated single causal family. Includes separate inter-route conflict regions.
